Collection Description
HW06 / Pool A / FR-06 - Product detail. Spec: GET /api/products/:id -> the product record. Generated from scripts/cases/api2_fr06_product_detail.py. This is the collection carrying the schema-validation evidence: the strict schema and the price-type assertions are repeated across every seeded product id, because type drift here is data-dependent and a single representative id would miss it. Fixtures always create their own throwaway products - the five seeded products are never modified or deleted, so no case can disturb another. --- CI REGRESSION GATE - generated, do not edit. Contains 54 reviewed deterministic cases from config/ci-suite.json. The full suite remains the source of defect evidence.
